# Nihongo Master - AI / LLM Context Documentation

> A complete Japanese language learning platform from Zero to JLPT N3 with a PWA web application.

## Core Documentation
- [Overview & Roadmap](GIAO_TRINH_TIENG_NHAT_N5_TO_N3.md): Comprehensive 4-stage study roadmap.
- [Cloudflare Tunnel Guide](HUONG_DAN_CLOUDFLARED.md): Step-by-step self-hosting and tunnel deployment instructions.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Version history and feature breakdown.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Guidelines for adding new lessons and materials.

## Study Curriculum Structure
- `00-nhap-mon/`: Hiragana, Katakana, Pronunciation & Greetings (4 lessons).
- `01-n5-so-cap-1/`: Minna no Nihongo I Lessons 1-25 + N5 Kanji + Grammar Cheatsheet (28 files).
- `02-n4-so-cap-2/`: Minna no Nihongo II Lessons 26-50 + Keigo Master (26 files).
- `03-n3-trung-cap/`: Shinkanzen Master N3 Grammar Chapters 1-12, Mimikara Vocab, Dokkai, Choukai (15 files).
- `04-luyen-de-n3/`: Full Mock Exam with detailed answer key.
- `tai-lieu-bo-tro/`: 214 Kanji Radicals & Complete Japanese Particle Guide.

## Web Application Stack
- **Architecture**: Static Web App with PWA offline caching (`manifest.json`, `sw.js`).
- **Server**: Zero-dependency Node.js HTTP Server (`server.js`) listening on port `3300`.
- **Docker**: Nginx Alpine container via `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml`.
